name: Manwol-ui Jeotaek
source:
In a remote mansion, deep within a silent forest, four men from different races whisper words of love to you.

Among them, who will find a place in your heart?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103170/Lunas_Twilight/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一座偏远的宅邸里，在一片寂静的森林深处，四个来自不同种族的男人向你低声诉说着爱的话语。

其中，谁会在你心中占有一席之地？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103170/Lunas_Twilight/]Steam[/url]]
